name: Deore thumb-shifter pair
weight_description: Complete left/right SL-MT60 thumb-shifter pair with 22.2 mm handlebar clamps and SIS/friction switching. Weight not yet sourced: the 1987 catalogue gives 210 g without explicitly identifying its pair basis; the figure is not doubled or assigned as a pair total.
